description: This record groups 4 public transport feed listing(s) attributed to 株式会社上信観光バス in the official Mobility Database inventory. The recorded geographic coverage is Maebashi, country code JP. The listing status counts on 2026-10-07 are 4 active. Formats are GTFS, GTFS Realtime. GTFS schedule feeds describe transit services for network and timetable modelling; GTFS Realtime listings identify operational update feeds where present. Each retained feed has its own catalogue-page link and provider endpoint when supplied without embedded access parameters. Licence information is recorded from the inventory; feed-use costs are not stated. Authentication requirements follow the source fields. Inactive, deprecated, future and development listings must not be treated as currently operating services. The feed contents, service dates and completeness were not inspected. These metadata support selecting inputs for public transport network and capacity studies. The related Mobility Database record provides the parent catalogue and the distinction between registry metadata and underlying data.
